newsitem.title: UK: BOBSLEIGH-BRITON BANNED FOR LIFE AFTER POSITIVE STEROID TEST.
newsitem.headline: BOBSLEIGH-BRITON BANNED FOR LIFE AFTER POSITIVE STEROID TEST.

text.p: British Olympic bobsledder Mark Tout has been banned for life after failing a random drugs test, the British Bobsleigh Association said on Monday.
Tout, a member of the British team at the last Winter Olympics, admitted the offence after testing positive for an anabolic steroid last month.

The British Bobsleigh Association said in a statement: "The life ban was imposed by the disciplinary committee of the British Bobsleigh Association and subsequently ratified by the sport's governing board.
"It is understood that the athlete, who has apologised, does not intend to appeal against the decision."

Tout helped British bobsleighers enjoy their best Winter Olympics for 30 years in Lillehammer in 1994. He was sixth with Lennox Paul in the two-man event and a member of the four-man team which finished fifth.
